footnote_text: Represents performance-based restricted share units ("PRSUs") granted to the Reporting Person on January 20, 2026 under the Issuer's 2014 Share Incentive Plan, as amended and restated, which were earned on October 30, 2026 as the result of the satisfaction of certain regulatory milestones. Each PRSU represents the contingent right to receive one Ordinary Share. These shares will vest on the later of (i) 10 business days after the receipt of certain regulatory clearance and (ii) January 20, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment by the Issuer through such vesting date.
